topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Towed from the driveway, she says. Could've been a mistake, but something in her eyes says this ain't no mix-up. Got a gut feeling there's more to this than meets the street. Asked her if she's sure about the address, if she's had any disputes, neighbors maybe pulling a fast one. Got that tight-lipped nod, the one that tells you ain't gonna get any more out of her till she's ready. Told her I'll check the tows, maybe a chat with the local PD, see what shakes loose. Noticed the way she clutched her purse, like it held all her answers. Gonna need more than what's on the surface to crack this one.
